title: Last drink
direction: Older American woman, warm worn-in lower register, gentle rasp and unhurried pace. Speaking privately while wiping down an empty bar. Affection under a hard-earned warning. Pause after 'Eyes on the door'. Finish simply, with concern, not melodrama.
text: Your old man sat in that same chair the night he got his big idea. Same smile, too. Eyes on the door. Look, I won't tell you how to live. Just leave enough of yourself to come back through here when the money's gone.
